claims.claim: Committed the H4A2 recovery as an additive delta confined to the seven authorized files, preserving existing configuration and canonical artifacts, with no real chat binding, credentials, or later-stage lifecycle behavior.

The reusable wake handoff requires successful admission status and complete admitted selectors, survives later Issue or artifact observability failures, and retains contents:read plus issues:write without actions:write.

The browser adapter attaches through locally configured CDP, requires exactly one matching authenticated regular ChatGPT page with an empty composer and no active generation, and contains no browser launch or page navigation.

Machine-local dedupe persists ATTEMPTING before submission and SUBMITTED only after bounded proof; duplicate SUBMITTED returns NOOP, while uncertain attempts and ambiguous state block automatic resend.

The doorbell and receipts contain bounded transport metadata; submission proof reads only the exact outbound user turn and local composer/send state, without assistant-output extraction or private binding disclosure.

Restored deterministic synthetic tests covering delivery, duplicate NOOP, binding errors, target-page uniqueness, surface authentication, draft and generation guards, submission failures and proof, enable gates, exact admission handoff, and permission bounds without live ChatGPT access.
